name: memizy-engine
description: Open-source Memizy engine: OQSE specification, plugin SDK, host SDK, multiplayer server and Plugin Lab.

scripts.build: bun run --filter "@memizy/oqse" build && bun run --filter "@memizy/protocol" build && bun run --filter "@memizy/plugin-sdk" build && bun run --filter "@memizy/host-sdk" build
scripts.test: bun run --filter "@memizy/oqse" build && bun run --filter "@memizy/protocol" build && bun run --filter "*" test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter "@memizy/oqse" build && bun run --filter "@memizy/protocol" build && bun run --filter "*" typecheck
